ALL-COPY LOCAL MINIMA AND TWO OBSTRUCTIONS TO GLOBAL EXTENSION
Coordinator derivation, 10 October 2026

STATUS: internally reconstructed scoped mathematics. The requested global
foundational theorem is NOT proved. Novelty and external validation are not
established. The local result below does not establish NPT bound entanglement.
Independent internal audits: work/round9/21_alln_audit.txt and 23_alln.txt.

DEFINITIONS AND GLOBAL TARGET

For C in M_(3^n)(C), let
  q_n(C) = sum_(S subset [n]) (-1/2)^|S| ||Tr_S C||_F^2.
Write L(A)=A-(Tr A)I_3/2. Then q_n(C)=<C,L^tensor n(C)>_HS.
The unresolved global target is q_n(C)>=0 for every n and every rank(C)<=2.
Two-copy positivity is already a July 2026 source theorem, not our discovery:
Song and Chen, https://arxiv.org/html/2607.23416v1 . The coordinator read its
main swap-sector and singular-value arguments; the local proof below does
not import that theorem. Another current two-copy source is
https://arxiv.org/html/2607.24479v1 .

1. COMPLETE LOCAL THEOREM

For every fixed n>=1, set D=2^n, x=0^n, y=1^n, s=(-1)^(n+1), and
  C0=|x><x|+s|y><y|.
There is a neighborhood of C0 within the complex rank-at-most-two matrices
on which q_n is nonnegative. Its zero set in a sufficiently small such
neighborhood is a smooth real manifold of dimension 4D-6+4n. All of these
zeroes are critical points of q_n restricted to rank two. The real Hessian
has that nullity and is strictly positive in normal directions.

The radius is not uniform in n; the theorem says nothing about matrices
outside these neighborhoods. We prove it on rank exactly two. This suffices
because C0 has two nonzero singular values and is separated from rank<=1.

Binary zero manifold.
Embed B=(C^2)^tensor n as the 0/1 coordinates. For C supported on B, let
F=Pi^tensor n, where Pi(A)=A-(Tr A)I_2/2 is the orthogonal projection onto
traceless 2-by-2 matrices. Compression of L to this block equals Pi, hence
  q_n(C)=<C,F(C)>=||F(C)||_F^2.
Put epsilon=[[0,1],[-1,0]], J=epsilon^tensor n, and theta(C)=J C^T J^(-1).
This is a complex-linear Hilbert-Schmidt isometric involution. Locally it
fixes I_2 and negates the traceless subspace, so
  F theta = (-1)^n F.
Since J^T=(-1)^n J, theta(C)=sC is equivalent to (CJ)^T=-CJ.
Every rank-two matrix in this spin-flip eigenspace therefore has q_n=0.

ERRATA AND EVIDENCE PRECEDENCE — 2026-10-10

All investigator reports are preliminary research records. A FAIL or
UNRESOLVED verdict is not an endorsement of every intermediate calculation.
The following errors were found; this is not a claim that no others remain.

Precedence: the five retained scoped derivations and this errata index,
then the explicit dated errata and focused audits, then the preliminary
reports. Later errata take precedence over earlier conflicting arithmetic.
Only claims explicitly discussed in a focused audit were audited. Do not
treat a filename containing 'freeze' or a report's self-description as a
cryptographic commitment; version-complete immutable snapshots were not made.

round1/01.txt: A scan-based simulation does not itself prove the invoked
O(t log t) universal-simulation overhead. That overhead must be imported from
an appropriate efficient universal-simulation theorem. No new hierarchy
theorem or self-contained proof of that simulation result was established.

round1/03.txt: For u=a cos(N x_1)(e_2+e_3) on a periodic domain containing
whole periods, ||u||_2^2=a^2 Vol and ||curl u||_2^2=a^2 N^2 Vol. The report's
values were twice these. Energy control is supercritical for the regularity
problem; the terminology 'subcritical' in that discussion must be corrected.

round1/12.txt: A width-w bucket has at most 2*3^w clauses containing either
polarity of the eliminated variable, not 3^w. The larger displayed headline
9^(w+1) bound still accommodates this count. See round1/12_challenge.txt.
The method is standard Davis–Putnam elimination with a supplied width bound.

round1/23_challenge.txt: For pure amplitudes (1,1,i)/sqrt(3), the matrix entry
rho_12 is -i/3, not +i/3 (zero-based labels). Reverse the corresponding block
phase. The phase-alignment principle and adjacent-coherence formula survive.

round1/24.txt: If two rounds each measure points with error at most rho,
true old positions have minimum separation Delta, and displacement is at
most eta, the sufficient nearest-neighbour margin is
2 eta + 4 rho < Delta. The weaker reported 2 eta + 2 rho margin is inadequate
under that measurement model.
